title: Fake Mass Shooting Call — Spoofed Number

fields.avatarBrief: anonymous local citizen, neutral expression, close-up on face
fields.text: BREAKING: A fake mass shooting call just came in on 555-0103 — a known spoofed number. The voice was calm and sounded like a recording. People are panicking. Is 911 still working? #RookCounty #911Down
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo of a social media post screen showing the text and a blurred background of a residential street
fields.attachedImageAlt: Screenshot of a social media post about a fake emergency call

instructorNote: Red herring inject; the fake call is not in CAD, and the shift must not escalate to Level 1 based on social media alone. Watch for premature escalation or overreaction to online panic.

citations.documentTitle: Rook County Emergency Communications District — ECC Operations and Continuity Plan
citations.quote: Swatting calls report a violent emergency at a specific person's or institution's address to draw an armed response. Signs: a caller who is calm, scripted or sounds like a recording; a call on a 10-di
